narr: A slow-moving cluster of thunderstorms developed across portions of eastern Oklahoma during the morning of the 8th, as an upper level disturbance approached the area from the northwest. The atmosphere was unusually moist, which enhanced the rainfall rates from the slow-moving thunderstorms. Locally heavy rainfall resulted in some flash flooding.
ev: Portions of a number of roads in and around Sallisaw were flooded and impassable.
lsr: Several reports of flooding throughout Sallisaw with a number of roads impassable.
